Explore new integrations, hands-on tutorials, and examples of building reliable applications. Whether you’re exploring Temporal or already building with it, find something to try in your next project.

Headed to AWS re:Invent next week? Hear Temporal and AWS leaders discuss building production-ready agents, talk through your use case with an expert, or stop by booth #738. Here’s where to find us in Vegas.

Temporal Cloud is now available on Azure in Public Preview, bringing managed Durable Execution to teams building on Azure.

11 AI integrations now Generally Available

Explore integrations for Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, AWS Strands, LangGraph, LangSmith, Gemini SDK, and AI SDK by Vercel. See how Temporal works with the tools you already use, with guides and examples featuring NVIDIA, Google Cloud, AWS, Modal, and more.

Encryption Validation at the Cloud Edge (Pre-Release)

Monitor payload encryption configuration at the Namespace level in Temporal Cloud. Encryption validation checks incoming payload metadata and can warn on or reject requests that don’t match your configured requirements.

Standalone Nexus Operations (Public Preview)

Invoke Nexus services directly from the Temporal SDK Client, with durable execution, automatic retries, and visibility, all without creating a caller Workflow.

External Storage automatically moves large payloads to customer-controlled object storage, keeping lightweight references in Event History. Public Preview support now includes the TypeScript, Java, .NET, Ruby, and Rust SDKs, joining Go and Python.

The team at Town is building AI assistants that help with meeting prep, follow-ups, and the tasks in between. In this interview, CEO Jean-Denis Greze talks through the engineering decisions behind the product, what happened when usage grew 10x at launch, and where Temporal fits in.

"Distributed systems are hard. If we don’t have to reinvent the wheel, why would we?" — Jean-Denis Greze, CEO, Town

What happens when a service goes down mid-order? Switch off parts of a food delivery app, then bring them back and watch it recover. No coding or sign-up required.

Write your first Temporal Workflow in TypeScript

Ready to try the code yourself? This interactive lab guides you through writing your first Temporal Workflow in TypeScript using an order-processing example.

But can it run DOOM? See how running the game as a Temporal Workflow demonstrates crash recovery, rebuilding game state, and rewinding gameplay with Reset.

Secure replication between self-hosted clusters

Running Temporal across multiple clusters? This walkthrough covers securing replication traffic with mutual TLS (mTLS), configuring certificates, and testing replication and failover.

Building self-improving agent loops with Temporal

Explore a prototype that evaluates complete agent runs, tunes prompts, and sends Slack notifications when prompts change.

Replay ’27 Super Early Bird tickets are now available! Replay brings together the developers, engineers, architects, technical leaders, and partners building the next generation of AI-powered applications and systems. Join us as we showcase how to push cutting-edge innovation faster, more safely, and more efficiently while maintaining reliability at the core of your systems.
